Description: This video features a historical interview with Donald Trump reflecting on the aftermath of the 9/11 attacks and the destruction at the World Trade Center. He discusses the enormous scale of the devastation and the difficult task of clearing the site, recovering victims, and beginning the rebuilding process. Drawing from his background in New York real estate, Trump comments on the engineering and logistical challenges involved in the recovery. He also highlights the efforts of workers, first responders, volunteers, and businesses that contributed to the cleanup and recovery at Ground Zero. The interview also focuses on the human impact of the attacks, including the grief experienced by victims’ families and the resilience shown by New Yorkers and people across the country. The discussion reflects the widespread desire to support those affected and help the city recover during an extraordinary national crisis.
